notes.content:
DISCOVER EGYPT!

notes.title: New Rescue Dash Update!
notes.content:
Dive into 30 new captivating escape room levels - more puzzles, more fun!

This update has brought in 30 brand new levels for you to enjoy. Each of these levels is an escape room style challenge, where you must solve puzzles, find clues, and use your logic and problem-solving skills to make your way out.

Updated the game screen to a cheerful summer theme for a more enjoyable experience.

To add to the enjoyment of the gaming experience, this update has also brought a graphical change to the game. This isn't just an aesthetic choice, it's designed to evoke the joy and relaxation often associated with summer, making the overall gaming experience more enjoyable and immersive for the players.

Fixed several bugs for smoother, uninterrupted gameplay.

Now, you can focus on solving the puzzles and advancing through the levels without being interrupted by technical glitches or bugs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402314/074dbb0e47ab3a90ab99c8eaf1807facb6486672.png

notes.title: Coins for Hard Levels!
notes.content:
Hey gamers!

Looking to earn some extra coins? 
We've got an exciting opportunity for you. Send us a video of you completing a difficult or super difficult level and earn rewards!


Here's what you need to do:
[olist]
 Record a video of yourself completing a difficult or super difficult level without using boosters.
 You can use your phone's recording feature or any other application. 
[olist]
 How to record screen on Android
 How to record screen on iOS
 How to record screen on PC
[/olist]
 Upload the video on YouTube, Google Drive or iCloud.
 Send us the link to that video via any of  the following media:
[olist]
 Discord
 In-game Help
 Web Help Center
[/olist]
 Don't forget to include your ID so we can send you the bounty!
[/olist]

Feel free to send us multiple videos of your impressive gaming skills.

Show us what you've got!
